AccountOut.description: What the backend keeps for an account. Name and email live with the identity provider.
AccountOut.title: AccountOut

AllowanceOut.description: The learner's voice minutes this week, in seconds (spec §6.19).
AllowanceOut.title: AllowanceOut

CardIn.description:
Which word or correction of a conversation's report to make a card of. The server reads
its content from the report; the app sends none.
CardIn.title: CardIn

CostsOut.description:
A month's estimated spending, for the owner (spec §6.19). Estimates from usage counts and
the configured prices, not the providers' invoices.
CostsOut.title: CostsOut

HomeOut.description: The Today screen in one answer.
HomeOut.title: HomeOut

LookModel.description: A portrait's parts and colors. The app draws exactly these names.
LookModel.title: LookModel

MemoriesOut.description: What the learner's partners know about them, and what the learner set (spec §6.11).
MemoriesOut.title: MemoriesOut

MemoryPatch.description:
What to change about one memory. A key left out is not a change; `day: null` takes an
event's day away.
MemoryPatch.title: MemoryPatch

MemorySettingsPatch.description: A setting left out stays as it is.
MemorySettingsPatch.title: MemorySettingsPatch

PersonaDraftOut.description: A persona that is not saved: a template, or one written from a description.
PersonaDraftOut.title: PersonaDraftOut

PersonaIn.description: A new persona. Personality and teaching left out (or null): as their role does.
PersonaIn.title: PersonaIn

PersonaPatch.description:
The parts of a persona to change; the ones left out stay. Personality or teaching set
to null go back to what the persona's role does.
PersonaPatch.title: PersonaPatch

PersonalityModel.description: How a persona comes across. Each trait is a point from 1 to 5 between two poles.
PersonalityModel.title: PersonalityModel

PictureUploadOut.description: How to send a photo: a form POST to `url` with `fields`, then the JPEG as `file`.
PictureUploadOut.title: PictureUploadOut

ProgressOut.description: The Progress screen in one answer.
ProgressOut.title: ProgressOut

TeachingModel.description:
How a persona treats mistakes and adapts to the learner. Every key is always present;
null means "as the learner's profile says" (or, for speed, the voice's own pace).
TeachingModel.title: TeachingModel

post.description:
Makes a flashcard of a word or a correction in a conversation's report. Saving one
that is a card already answers with that card.

Asks for a report that is not there: for an earlier conversation, or again after one
failed. Answers at once; the report is written in the background.

get.description: What the learner's partners know about them from earlier conversations.

patch.description: Turns memory on or off, or names the topics partners leave alone.

get.description: A month's estimated spending (this month unless `month` names its first day).
Whether the audio of the learner's conversations is kept (spec §6.6).

patch.description: Keeps recordings, or stops: stopping deletes every recording kept so far.

post.description: Asks the Tutor about one correction of a conversation's report (spec §6.5).

get.description: The questions the learner asked the Tutor, newest first.

post.description: Asks the Tutor a question about the language learned (spec §6.8).
